_comment: Curated optimization set. Order is priority: when two mods conflict, the later optional one is dropped. Each jar is downloaded from Modrinth at install time and verified by SHA-512; nothing is redistributed. 'expectedLicense' is informational; the resolver reports the license Modrinth currently lists.

mods.name: Fabric API
mods.role: Required Fabric hooks (HUD, key mappings, events)

mods.name: Sodium
mods.role: Rendering engine: chunk meshing, culling, draw batching. The largest single FPS gain.

mods.name: Lithium
mods.role: Game logic (physics, AI, ticking). Helps the integrated server in singleplayer and client-side entity ticking.

mods.name: FerriteCore
mods.role: Memory: deduplicates block-state and model data, lowering heap use and GC work.

mods.name: ImmediatelyFast
mods.role: Batches immediate-mode rendering (HUD, text, entities, maps), which Sodium does not cover.

mods.name: Entity Culling
mods.role: Skips entities and block entities hidden behind terrain (ray-cast occlusion; complements Sodium's chunk-level culling).

mods.name: ModernFix
mods.role: Faster startup and lower memory use from resource loading and model fixes.

mods.name: Dynamic FPS
mods.role: Throttles rendering when the window is unfocused or hidden. Vanilla only throttles minimized windows.

mods.name: More Culling
mods.role: Extra face culling (leaves, item frames, ...). Off by default: it can change leaf visuals.

mods.name: C2ME
mods.role: Parallel chunk generation for singleplayer worlds. Off by default: experimental and only helps world generation.
